content: The CLEAR Outcomes study investigated the effectiveness of bempedoic acid in patients with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) or those at high cardiovascular risk who were unable to tolerate statins. The trial demonstrated a 13% reduction in the incidence of major cardiovascular events when compared to placebo. These primary outcomes included reductions in cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, and coronary revascularization procedures. Additionally, bempedoic acid was shown to significantly lower LDL cholesterol levels, reinforcing its potential as an alternative therapeutic option for managing cardiovascular risk in individuals who cannot tolerate statins.
